description: This file defines the ManufacturerDao interface, which declares methods for accessing and manipulating Manufacturer data, such as listing manufacturers by store or category, and counting attached products.

methods.name: listByStore
methods.description: Returns a list of manufacturers associated with a specific store and optionally filtered by language.

methods.name: listByStore
methods.description: Returns a list of manufacturers associated with a specific store.

methods.name: getCountManufAttachedProducts
methods.description: Returns the count of products attached to a given manufacturer.

methods.name: listByProductsByCategoriesId
methods.description: Returns a list of manufacturers filtered by store, a list of category IDs, and language.
